gate_definition.requirement: The Phase-D shared G pass MUST reproduce the existing Phase27 frozen global probability cache. Newly extracted stored f16 global probabilities are compared against the Phase27 frozen cache. Preferred outcome: bit-identical.
gate_definition.on_non_identical: report max_abs, mismatch count, and affected sample IDs; then STOP before seed123/3407 downstream VAL808 inference unless already authorized.

reference_target.role: Phase27 frozen global probability cache (authoritative reproduction target)

observed_divergence_audit.note: Disclosed for governance completeness. This comparison reads ONLY already-persisted cache files; it performs no model inference and no VAL808 population access beyond the frozen cached arrays. It is reported because the divergence directly motivates the gate.
observed_divergence_audit.interpretation: The v1.1 (FP32/no-autocast) cache differs from the Phase27 autocast-fp16 cache across 38.7% of stored f16 values. This is consistent with fp16 autocast quantization drift and confirms that reproducing Phase27 requires the v1.2 autocast-fp16 semantics.

required_phase_d_global_extraction_seman.batch_partition: contiguous chunks of 8 inside a single domain

reproduction_requirement: The newly extracted and stored f16 global probability MUST reproduce phase27_val808_global_prob_f16.npy. PRIMARY requirement: bit-identical.
on_non_identity: STOP before any downstream (seed123/3407) VAL808 inference. Record max_abs, number mismatched, affected sample IDs, and batch IDs.
